review_candidates.title: Expert Backend Engineer (Get Discovered)
review_candidates.description: About Jimdo We exist to unleash the power of the self-employed - helping solopreneurs and micro-businesses thrive by doing what they're passionate about and removing the complexity of building lasting, successful businesses. Jimdo started in 2007 when three school friends built a website builder in a Northern German farmhouse to help everyone build a presence online. Today, we're a profitable, remote-first company with 220+ people from 50+ nationalities working across 15+ countries. We've helped build over 36 million websites to get online across the world. We're more than just a website builder. We're an AI-powered platform that helps self-employed people actually run and build successful businesses — from getting found online, winning customers and running their business with a peace of mind by knowing exactly what to do next to move forward. At the heart of Jimdo is a strong belief in personalized, data-driven guidance. Our platform combines design, business tools, and an AI-powered core that turns real customer data into clear insights and next steps helping our customers focus on what moves their business forward. Role Overview The Get Discovered team`s vision is to empower small businesses not only to get online - but to get found. That means helping them optimize for search, own their digital presence, advertise effectively, and track what’s working. As an Expert Backend Engineer, you’ll serve as a technical leader with deep backend expertise, driving architecture, system design, reliability, and engineering excellence. You’ll work on scalable backend systems, integrations with external partners, data flows, APIs, and operationally reliable services. At the same time, this is not a backend-only role. We expect you to contribute meaningfully across the product surface, including frontend work where needed. You should be comfortable collaborating with frontend engineers, understanding React and TypeScript codebases, and helping deliver end-to-end customer value rather than stopping at service boundaries. Working closely with Product, Design, Data, and Engineering teams, you’ll influence strategic decisions, lead complex technical initiatives, and help shape the future of AI-first software development at Jimdo. This is an expert-level individual contributor role with significant autonomy and influence. You'll act as a technical anchor across teams, championing modern engineering practices and leveraging AI to improve productivity, quality, and innovation. Your Impact Design and evolve scalable, reliable, and maintainable systems across frontend, backend, and data layers. Lead architectural decisions, define engineering standards, and drive Architecture Decision Records (ADRs). Own and deliver complex technical initiatives end-to-end, translating business goals into actionable technical roadmaps. Contribute meaningfully across the product, leveraging your holistic understanding of the system to help the team deliver complete customer outcomes—including frontend implementation when needed. Mentor engineers and elevate technical excellence through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and best-practice development. Champion AI-assisted engineering workflows and help teams leverage AI-first development practices. Drive improvements in testing, CI/CD, observability, system reliability, and operational excellence. Collaborate closely with Product, Design, Data, and Engineering leadership to influence strategy and deliver customer value. Manage operational and technical dependencies with external vendors and partners, including platforms such as Google Workspace, domain providers, email services, and RankingCoach. What You Bring 8+ years of engineering experience in product-led environments, including experience operating at a technical lead, staff, or principal level. Deep backend expertise with technologies such as Kotlin, Java, or Node.js. Strong experience designing APIs, distributed systems, service architectures, integrations, and reliable production systems. Solid frontend capability, especially with React and TypeScript — you do not need to be frontend-specialized, but you can contribute meaningfully to frontend implementation and technical discussions. Proven track record leading large-scale architectural, platform, integration, or modernization initiatives. Deep understanding of software architecture, testing strategies, CI/CD, observability, and operational excellence. Strong experience collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders and influencing technical direction across multiple teams. Excellent communication skills and the ability to mentor and guide engineers. Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude, or similar technologies. Experience establishing engineering standards and best practices across an organization. Passion for building products that help entrepreneurs and small businesses succeed. What We Offer Inspiring Mission: At our core, we are driven by a meaningful mission - to empower solopreneurs and small businesses to succeed and to contribute to the sustainability and vibrancy of the communities they serve. Flexibility and Trust: Our work environment thrives on flexibility and trust. We offer fully remote work set-up with opportunities for in-person collaboration. You can manage your working hours flexibly because we prioritize the results you deliver over the number of hours you put in. An International Diverse Team: Our team is a mosaic of over 220+ individuals hailing from 50+ different countries and working across 15+ diverse locations. We take pride in our openness and inclusivity, with an Employee-led DEI Council and active ERGs that ensure everyone's voices are heard. Continuous Growth and Career Development: We invest in your growth with company-wide access to LinkedIn Learning and Hack Weeks, Deep Work Thursdays, conferences and access to technical eLearning platforms. From day one, you have the chance to contribute your ideas and create a meaningful impact. Our flat hierarchies and swift decision-making processes provide an open platform for your career progression. Competitive Benefits Package Annual compensation reviews to ensure you're rewarded fairly. A remote office set-up bonus to enhance your workspace. An employee assistance program, offering resources and counseling. Plus, a perk that keeps giving: up to three free Jimdo websites for your personal or professional projects that you get to keep forever. Jimdo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. This means that we don’t discriminate based on race or ethnic origin, color, the language(s) you speak, where you (or your parents) are from, or whether or not you consider yourself to have a disability. Neither will your age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, beliefs, or political opinions play a part in your application with us. Our diverse team values and celebrates the uniqueness of each individual. We embrace differences and believe that they enrich our organization, making us stronger and more innovative. Join us, and let's continue to create a workplace where everyone can thrive, regardless of background or identity. By sending your application, you declare that you read and understand the Jimdo Applicant Privacy Policy

review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same. Job Description Scope of Work Take on lower-priority engineering work the team lacks bandwidth for, including compliance, engineering maintenance, cost-savings, observability, experiment clean-up, and operational tooling. Design, build, and maintain scalable, performant, and reliable software systems. Contribute to system architecture and technical design, validating solutions through data and experimentation where appropriate. Participate in code and design reviews. Collaborate with software engineers, product managers, data scientists, and designers. Clarify requirements and perform mid-level design work, focusing on coding, testing, and documentation. Must-Have Skills 3–5 years of professional, backend-focused software development experience. Java and/or Kotlin. MongoDB Atlas or similar modern NoSQL database experience. Aurora MySQL on AWS or similar relational database experience. Cloud-native distributed systems on AWS.Spring Boot.GraphQL API development (Netflix DGS). Experience building and operating large-scale, high-performance, resilient systems. Strong English communication and collaboration skills. Nice-to-Have Skills Event-driven system development with Kafka and/or SQS. AI-assisted coding experience. Terraform. Microservices.gRPC and REST API development. Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

review_candidates.title: Ingénieur Full Stack
review_candidates.description: Nous recherchons un(e) Développeur(se) Full-Stack expérimenté(e) pour intervenir à temps partiel sur plusieurs plateformes digitales et SaaS déjà en cours de développement. Description du rôle Le ou la Développeur·se Web participerera à la conception, au développement et à la maintenance des fonctionnalités du site et des applications web associées. Au quotidien, la personne prendra en charge l’implémentation d’interfaces utilisateur, l’intégration de maquettes, l’optimisation des performances et la résolution de bugs. Elle collaborera avec l’équipe produit et design pour traduire les besoins fonctionnels en solutions techniques fiables et évolutives. Il s’agit d’un poste à temps partiel en tant que freelance, en mode hybride : basé à Alger, avec une partie du travail réalisable à distance. Qualifications Maîtrise du développement logiciel et de la programmation, avec une bonne connaissance des langages couramment utilisés pour le web (par exemple JavaScript, PHP, Python). Compétences en développement web et front-end, incluant HTML, CSS, frameworks modernes (tels que React, Vue ou équivalent) et intégration responsive. Expérience dans la conception, la manipulation et l’optimisation de bases de données relationnelles ou NoSQL. Capacité à travailler en équipe dans un environnement agile, sens de l’organisation, autonomie et souci de la qualité du code (tests, documentation, revues de code). Bonnes aptitudes de communication écrite et orale, curiosité technique, veille sur les bonnes pratiques du web et capacité à apprendre rapidement de nouvelles technologies. 🎯 Missions • Reprise et amélioration de développements existants • Intégration de designs et maquettes sur le front-end • Développement et correction de fonctionnalités back-end • Intégration et sécurisation des workflows de paiement • Développement de systèmes de réservation / prise de rendez-vous • Dashboards utilisateurs et professionnels • Workflows SaaS et automatisations • Tests fonctionnels, debugging et corrections • Déploiement régulier des développements • gestion de projet suivi des tickets et versions sur GitHub 💻 Profil recherché Nous recherchons surtout quelqu’un de : ✓ réellement Full-Stack ✓ autonome et rapide dans la compréhension d'un projet existant ✓ à l'aise avec les API et intégrations de paiement ✓ capable de reprendre et améliorer du code existant ✓ rigoureux dans les tests et le debugging ✓ habitué à travailler avec GitHub ✓ capable de travailler à partir de maquettes/prototypes réalisés notamment avec Lovable ✓ à l'aise avec les outils de développement assistés par IA ⏱️ Organisation Mission part-time, organisée en sessions de développement avec objectifs et livrables clairement définis. Chaque session fait l'objet d'un suivi simple : démarrage → développement → test → déploiement → validation. Nous recherchons une personne disponible pour une collaboration régulière, avec possibilité d'évolution de la rémunération en equity selon les performances relevées. 📩 Pour candidater, merci d'envoyer : • CV ou profil LinkedIn • GitHub / portfolio / exemples de projets réalisés (projets concrets) • stack technique maîtrisée • disponibilités • TJM ou tarif horaire • localisation Disponibilité rapide souhaitée.

review_candidates.title: Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: We're hiring on behalf of a Haystack partner! The Role • Design and implement distributed storage systems handling real-world workloads at significant scale. • Tackle complex challenges in replication, consistency, and fault tolerance for large-scale data. • Engage in systems-level programming for storage engines and critical data paths. • Operate and maintain services at scale, including performance tuning and debugging. • Build tooling and automation to enhance team efficiency in managing large infrastructure. • Participate in on-call rotations, focusing on operational excellence and root cause analysis. What You'll Need • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field. • 3+ years of professional software development experience. • 2+ years of experience in designing or architecting new and existing systems, including reliability and scaling. • 1+ years of experience designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, or distributed software applications using languages like C++, Java, or Rust. • Experience with Object-Oriented Design principles. • Familiarity with distributed systems at scale and consensus protocols is a plus. What's On Offer • Competitive annual salary ($143,700 - $194,400) plus potential sign-on bonuses and stock units. • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge distributed storage technologies. • Comprehensive benefits package including health insurance, 401(k) matching, and paid time off. • Continuous learning, mentorship, and career growth opportunities within a leading cloud platform provider. Apply via Haystack today!
